span.p:
Where the X posts come from:
1. Once a day a GitHub Action calls X with the secret.
2. It commits the results to data/x_posts.csv.
3. The dashboard and #monitor both just read that file.
The site never calls X and X numbers are up to ~24 h old.
Posts are cards that link out to x.com, not live embeds.
